rows.title: Parity policy
rows.rule: Reproduce business definitions and visual forms; never security defects; fix nondeterminism; quirks that change a number → parity metric + named corrected metric.

rows.title: Parity classification of REF findings
rows.rule: §3.4 rulings; soft-deleted fit-out rows only in parity cards, never in insights or recommendations.
rows.note: Per-metric confirmation in M0 KPI batches.

rows.title: Frozen as_of per data version
rows.rule: One as_of used by seed, SQL, APIs, agent, insights and fixtures; NOW() banned in metric SQL.

rows.title: as_of value and data window
rows.rule: as_of 2026-10-20; transactional events 2024-01-01 → as_of.
rows.note: Batch approval. All designs already use these values.

rows.title: Monitoring is synthetic historical replay
rows.rule: Detectors replayed at checkpoints ≤ as_of; never live monitoring.
rows.note: Calendar fixed by DXD-75 (weekly, monthly on the 20th, events).

rows.title: Time zones
rows.rule: Store UTC; bucket every calendar filter and age band in Asia/Riyadh.

rows.title: Apache ECharts for dashboard and GenUI charts
rows.rule: Conditional on faithful V2 reproduction, treemap fidelity and chart accessibility.
rows.note: Real-runtime validation still outstanding (DXD-21, DXD-61); fallback DXD-23.

rows.title: Non-chart visuals as HTML
rows.rule: Stage flow approved; stat tiles, occupancy meter, permit strip, captions proposed.
rows.note: Batch approval: freeze the remaining HTML visuals at GD (built and verified in DX2/DX3).

rows.title: Level 5 in scope after the core agent
rows.rule: Insight discovery, monitoring, notifications, lifecycle and feedback.

rows.title: Sequencing M3c → M6 after M5
rows.rule: Core agent evaluated without Level 5; proactive work after.
rows.note: Five-day plan reorders delivery (see feasibility); the dependency stays.

rows.title: In-app notifications only
rows.rule: Inbox, badge, per-user list; no email, SMS or push.

rows.title: Meaning of feedback
rows.rule: Stored; drives deterministic re-ranking, suppression and evaluation reports.
rows.note: Conflicts with DXD-72 (logged for review only). Decision GDQ-05.

rows.title: Read-only business data
rows.rule: Application state in separate schemas written by a separate DB role.

rows.title: Provider-agnostic LLM adapter
rows.rule: Model is configuration; structured output and tool calling required.

rows.title: Model roles and selection
rows.rule: planner / synthesizer / fast keys; benchmark two candidates.
rows.note: Provider and API key needed before agent work starts (GDQ-12).

rows.title: Plain @ag-ui/client
rows.rule: Own React hooks and the GenUI registry; no CopilotKit.

rows.title: AG-UI event mapping
rows.rule: CUSTOM cenomi.presentation.v1, ACTIVITY_* plan, sanitized TOOL_CALL_*, STATE_* context; no reasoning events.
rows.note: Design contract DXD-40; SDK assumptions verified against the pinned version (GDQ-11 spike).

rows.title: Synthetic sales_funnel_snapshot
rows.rule: Live card counts; snapshot divergence explained.

rows.title: No approvals filter-list snapshot table
rows.rule: Filter options from live data.

rows.title: Simplified, backend-enforced roles and permissions
rows.rule: Final role list in M0.
rows.note: POC fixture roles used in design: portfolio admin, Central manager, tenant (one lease, company).

rows.title: Scope semantics
rows.rule: Explicit scope kinds; empty scope = empty result; card and endpoint share a permission; client can only narrow; refs bound to principal, scope, data version.

rows.title: Row-level security not in baseline
rows.rule: Mandatory scope fragment + lint + read-only role.

rows.title: Explicit lineage
rows.rule: enquiry → proposal → lease; unit → inspection → drawing → handover via fitout_projects.
rows.note: No designed journey uses it yet (PRD journey 3) — GDQ-09.

rows.title: Lineage metrics labelled new
rows.rule: Cohort conversion, inspection → handover lag.
rows.note: Batch approval with the KPI catalog.

rows.title: English-first UI
rows.rule: Arabic names stored for fidelity (proposed); no RTL.
rows.note: English-first approved at G0; Arabic storage in the batch approval.

rows.title: Agent proposes dashboard filter changes; user confirms
rows.rule: Frontend tool propose_dashboard_filters.

rows.title: Prospective-tenant journey
rows.rule: Stretch goal.

rows.title: Tech stack
rows.rule: Python 3.12, FastAPI, Pydantic v2, SQLAlchemy Core, psycopg 3, Alembic, uv; Node 22, pnpm, Next.js, TS, TanStack Query, zod; PostgreSQL 16; pytest, Vitest, Playwright; OpenTelemetry.
rows.note: Batch approval; versions pinned in M0.

rows.title: Pydantic → JSON Schema → TS + zod
rows.rule: CI drift check.

rows.title: Conversation and run state in PostgreSQL schema agent
rows.rule: No Redis.
rows.note: Batch approval. Insight tables in schema insights (DX6).

rows.title: Metric registry as YAML; SQL templates as files
rows.rule: Startup validation and scope lint.

rows.title: Narrative numbers only from fact tokens
rows.rule: Verifier rejects other numbers; one retry; deterministic template.

rows.title: Lifecycle with bounded re-plan
rows.rule: plan → validate → DAG → ≤ 1 re-plan → facts → synthesis → verify → compose.

rows.title: Two-tier fixtures
rows.rule: Micro hand-verified fixtures; process-based macro seed with property assertions.
rows.note: DX6 adds golden cohorts and invariants (DXD-81).

rows.title: Repository naming
rows.rule: Project-instruction docs/ and plans/ names; TA §11 code layout.

rows.title: Planning documents committed manually
rows.rule: Option A.

rows.title: Evaluation scoring
rows.rule: Deterministic checks; LLM judge for explanation quality; ≥ 20% human spot-check.

rows.title: Local Docker Compose
rows.rule: No cloud deployment.

rows.title: Optional technical spike
rows.rule: Throwaway AG-UI round trip and model latency.

rows.title: Design references
rows.rule: Design from the API Reference.

rows.title: Brand treatment
rows.rule: Cenomi-inspired, fictional data, synthetic indicator, no brand assets.

rows.title: Design before specifications
rows.rule: Gate GD before M0 specifications.

rows.title: New and corrected metrics only via the KPI catalog
rows.rule: No silent scope expansion.
rows.note: Batch approval. Adds three as-of metrics (DXD-80).

rows.title: Scale and geography
rows.rule: 3 regions, 25 fictional malls, PRD §8 targets.
rows.note: Batch approval; used by every design.

rows.title: Units and numeric policy
rows.rule: SAR, m², 1-decimal %, integers, — with a reason.

rows.title: Detector set and priority formula
rows.rule: Robust z, peer outlier, trend break, co-movement; impact × severity × confidence.

rows.title: Normalized fitout_drawing_documents
rows.rule: Not parsed from JSON.

rows.title: Simplified location hierarchy
rows.rule: region → mall → property → unit; explicit property_groups.

rows.title: Visual direction
rows.rule: Ink and Violet is the primary design system. Night Operations may follow later as an optional dark theme; Warm Editorial is not pursued.

rows.title: Screen architecture
rows.rule: Four screens — Admin or Tenant dashboard, Analytical workspace, Insight inbox — plus the docked agent panel and four overlays: card focus, inspector, notifications, filter-change confirmation.
rows.note: Notifications overlay: GDQ-08 proposes the bell opens the inbox instead.

rows.title: Agent UX
rows.rule: Hybrid: docked agent panel for quick questions; expandable analytical workspace for multi-step investigations; contextual entry points on every card and data point.

rows.title: Shared inspector
rows.rule: One inspector with Evidence, Definition, Records and Execution tabs, used for dashboard metrics, generated components and proactive insights alike.
rows.note: Insight detail (DX6) must reuse the inspector’s evidence components (consolidation C-01).

rows.title: Three kinds of context
rows.rule: Visibly separate (1) card-level dashboard filters, set on the card; (2) the agent's analytical query scope, which the user can narrow or widen in the panel without touching the dashboard; (3) proposed dashboard filter changes, which apply only after…

rows.title: State preservation
rows.rule: Moving between dashboard and workspace keeps the conversation, selected data points, card filters, pinned results and scroll position.

rows.title: Responsive behaviour
rows.rule: Desktop, tablet and mobile designs. Below desktop width the agent opens as an overlay (tablet) or full screen (mobile) instead of permanently narrowing charts.

rows.title: Statement labels
rows.rule: Every analytical statement carries a text label — Observed, Derived, Hypothesis, Recommendation, Unavailable. Colour supports the label and is never the only signal; hypotheses also use a dashed outline.

rows.title: Synthetic data
rows.rule: The reference date and the synthetic-data designation stay visible on every screen, and every card footer repeats "As of 20 Oct 2026 · synthetic data".

rows.title: Expanded cards
rows.rule: Keep the centred overlay for quick inspection. Every expanded card also offers Open in workspace , which moves the card into the analytical workspace with its filters, selection and active tab intact.

rows.title: Records vs Inspector
rows.rule: Dashboard drilldowns live in the card’s Records tab. The shared Inspector is reserved for evidence, definitions, calculation provenance and execution details. Both reuse the same table and dataset components.

rows.title: Selection model
rows.rule: One active selection globally is the agent’s default context. Each card remembers its own last selection. The user can explicitly pin several selections for a cross-KPI comparison; unrelated selections are never combined automatically.
rows.note: Superseded for analytical context by DXD-29 → DXD-32; per-card memory kept.

rows.title: Mall map
rows.rule: Out of the baseline. Keep the mall cards, available-unit counts, regions and actions.

rows.title: Partial coverage everywhere
rows.rule: The same Partial label and a sentence naming what is missing (“covers 18 of 25 malls”) on dashboard charts and on agent-generated components. Coverage is a field of the result, not text the model writes.

rows.title: Filters vs boundaries
rows.rule: Analytical filters are removable chips. Authorization boundaries (role access, lease restriction) and the frozen reference date sit in a separate Boundaries row with a lock icon. Neither the user nor the agent can remove or widen them in the panel.

rows.title: One state vocabulary
rows.rule: Cards and generative components share one set of states: loading , zero (shown as 0), empty (no match · before dataset · after reference date), unavailable (not in the dataset), error (reference and Retry), outside_access , partial , undefined_ratio (zero…

rows.title: Context and scroll preservation
rows.rule: Opening or closing any overlay (expanded card, agent sheet, filter sheet, inspector) keeps page scroll, card filters, selection and active tab.

rows.title: Chart and table share one dataset
rows.rule: Chart, Table and Records read the same authorized result for the card’s scope. A table may show finer rows (Other expanded) but its totals must reconcile with the chart.

rows.title: Phone navigation
rows.rule: Below 820 px the side rail becomes a bottom tab bar, matching the approved Responsive board.

rows.title: Value labels on narrow charts
rows.rule: When direct value labels would collide, show the value on the selected mark and in the tooltip; the Table tab lists every value.

rows.title: How DR-007 is verified
rows.rule: First, run the gallery’s self-test in Play with real ECharts loaded and review the result. If the library cannot load in the canvas, validate with a local, version-pinned ECharts asset. Test-double runs never count as proof.
rows.note: ECharts runtime could not be loaded from this workspace (egress refused); GDQ-06.

rows.title: minShare 0.08
rows.rule: Option A, provisionally. Every treemap category and sub-category stays a tile with its drilldown; the threshold only decides label visibility. Confirm against the original ui-kit source if available.
rows.note: Option A provisional; no ui-kit source available — batch approval to make it final.

rows.title: Treemap fallback
rows.rule: If ECharts misses the agreed fidelity, accessibility or interaction thresholds, both treemaps use the custom squarified component. ECharts stays for the other suitable chart types.

rows.title: V2 palette with verified accessibility
rows.rule: Keep the V2 hues. Every chart must still have accessible labels, visible focus indicators, text alternatives and selection states that do not rely on colour. WCAG compliance is verified, not assumed: a table alternative does not settle every contrast…
rows.note: WCAG verified on the real build (axe-core, screen reader).

rows.title: One selection contract
rows.rule: Every selectable chart, table row, tile and generated component emits selection_ref.v1 : dashboard cards, the agent panel, the workspace and generative UI alike.

rows.title: What a selection carries
rows.rule: A semantic metric identifier with version and kind (parity or corrected), grain, dimensions, value and unit, filter context, authorization scope, and a validated dataset reference (dataset version, as-of date, result reference).

rows.title: Chart ↔ table keeps the definition
rows.rule: Switching a chart to its table (dashboard card or generated component) reads the same result reference: same metric definition, grain, filters and access scope. A table may show finer rows only if they reconcile with the chart totals.

rows.title: Same semantics everywhere
rows.rule: Selecting in the workspace or in a generated chart behaves exactly as on the dashboard: same states, the same Ask and View records actions, the same payload.

rows.title: Active, kept and pinned
rows.rule: One active selection globally is the agent’s default context. Each card or component keeps its own last selection, which is never sent automatically. Multi-selection analysis happens only after the user explicitly pins selections.

rows.title: Grounded numbers
rows.rule: Every displayed number comes from the shared synthetic dataset. In the design prototypes, figures are computed by the DX2 model functions that draw the dashboard. In the product, they come from metric-service results. The model never types a number.

rows.title: Composite rankings only on request
rows.rule: DXQ-05 · Option C. By default the agent answers prioritisation questions with a multi-KPI comparison table, the leader on each KPI (marked “Leader” in text), magnitude and severity, and a narrative that states its ordering rule. A combined score is…

rows.title: Analytical selections are thread-local
rows.rule: DXQ-06 · Option C. Each investigation keeps its own active, kept and pinned selections and scope chips. The dashboard keeps its selection state separately. A selection crosses into an investigation only by explicit import (Ask about this, or Import a…

rows.title: History is immutable
rows.rule: DXQ-07 · Option A. Resumed investigations show answers exactly as generated, with their dataset version. Re-run with current data is an explicit action that creates a new run; stored answers never change and are never refreshed silently.

rows.title: KPI reconciliation (finding)
rows.rule: J1’s 41 and J3’s 32 measure different populations of the same KPI at Rawdah Point: 41 is all approval types older than a month; 32 is proposals of all ages. Both reconcile (table below). No synthetic-data correction was needed and no KPI definition…

rows.title: Coverage semantics
rows.rule: An observed total from incomplete reports is labelled “observed subset” with its coverage (J4: 87 of 3,000 checked units, 18 of 25 malls). The full-portfolio total is an Unavailable card (“—”), never estimated. Partial coverage is inherited by every…

rows.title: Evidence envelope on every statement and visual
rows.rule: Every statement and generated component carries: evidence class, metric ids and versions, filters (inherited from the answer when a derived value has none of its own, and marked so), authorization scope, freshness (as-of date), dataset version, and…

rows.title: Versioned recovery
rows.rule: A successful retry of a failed node is a new run that creates answer v2 (“revises v1”). v1 is preserved exactly as generated, labelled “superseded · kept unchanged”, and both appear in the inspector’s Versions list. Run again after Stop is also a new run…

rows.title: Context isolation rules
rows.rule: Switching threads, changing roles, removing scope chips and resuming investigations can never widen authorization or import context implicitly. Imports and resumes are re-checked against the current access scope; mismatches are refused or dropped with a…

rows.title: Accessibility of evidence, activity and selection
rows.rule: Evidence labels, coverage, version and connection states are text. Selectable rows, bars and cells expose aria-pressed and a text state. The inspector is a dialog that takes focus, supports Escape and restores focus; tabs use arrow keys. One polite live…
rows.note: axe-core and screen reader on the real build.

rows.title: AG-UI handoff contracts
rows.rule: Event-to-state mapping, run identity (threadId, runId, requestId, seq), cancellation, interruption and reconnection, retry kinds and idempotency are fixed as design contracts on DX4-AGUI. Assumptions about the AG-UI SDK are listed for verification against…
rows.note: SDK assumptions verified against the pinned AG-UI version (GDQ-11).

rows.title: The result is authoritative
rows.rule: Generated components render values only from the validated result named by resultRef; payload text uses fact tokens only.

rows.title: Closed component registry
rows.rule: Fifteen approved kinds; no model-generated code; new kinds through design review.

rows.title: Representation alternates
rows.rule: View as switches representation without modifying or re-querying the result.

rows.title: One formatting module
rows.rule: Counts, rates, SAR, missing, zero and undefined formatted once, for every representation.

rows.title: State vocabulary
rows.rule: Default, partial, zero, empty, undefined ratio, loading, error, unavailable; never conflated.

rows.title: Size classes
rows.rule: Workspace 760, panel 420, canvas 360, phone 358, expanded 1000; per-kind responsive rules.

rows.title: Validation and fallback
rows.rule: Server-side validation with client-side defensive re-validation. Amended by DXD-57: the deterministic table only for presentation failures on a resolved, authorized, verified result.

rows.title: Envelope per component
rows.rule: Every component prints the evidence envelope; a payload envelope that disagrees is rejected.

rows.title: Drilldown and selection
rows.rule: Marks are buttons with names, aria-pressed and “Selected” text; arrows, Enter, Escape; selection_ref.v1 into the investigation; records from the same population.

rows.title: Fixtures are labelled
rows.rule: Design-only state fixtures are labelled; production never renders fixtures.

rows.title: Bounded representation policy (DXQ-08 A)
rows.rule: The agent selects among allowed representations using intent, result shape, dimensions, accessibility preference and display space (rules P1–P6); the user switches with View as.

rows.title: Deterministic table fallback (DXQ-09 A)
rows.rule: An invalid presentation payload falls back to a table from the verified, authorized result.

rows.title: Treemap below 400 px (DXQ-10 A)
rows.rule: Becomes a ranked list with the same keys and selection.

rows.title: Component budget (DXQ-11 A)
rows.rule: At most three generated components in the docked panel and six in the workspace; further supporting information through Open in workspace and the inspector.

rows.title: Verified calculations
rows.rule: Every derived value originates from a verified calculation recording method, operands, comparison periods, metric definition and evidence references. The verifier recomputes it. Neither the LLM nor the renderer derives business KPI values; the renderer…

rows.title: Authorization by grants
rows.rule: Validate the viewer’s current grants against the result scope, dimension values and records; never compare labels. Revalidate stored and resumed results. Withhold rather than filter a partly-authorized result; never name out-of-grant entities.

rows.title: Failure taxonomy
rows.rule: Presentation, calculation, authorization, unknown result, stale and partial are distinct classes with distinct outcomes. Only presentation failures with valid, authorized results use the table fallback.

rows.title: Fallback preserves boundaries
rows.rule: The fallback keeps row limits and paging, evidence, partial coverage, formatting and authorization.

rows.title: Subset disclosure
rows.rule: Any subset, top-N, page, sample or aggregate is declared and disclosed in text; the renderer never aggregates.

rows.title: Continuity
rows.rule: Envelope and selection semantics are preserved across View as, panel ↔ workspace moves, expansion and resume (resume re-runs authorization).

rows.title: ECharts at the Design Gate
rows.rule: Final Design Gate validates the GenUI charts on the pinned Apache ECharts runtime (5.6.0) — rendering, names, keyboard, selection, resize, subset disclosure — not on HTML stand-ins.

rows.title: Implementation priority
rows.rule: Registry keeps 15 kinds; ten core kinds first, five specialized kinds wrap DX3 primitives or simple layouts; unbuilt kinds render through the table fallback.
rows.note: Specialized kinds deferrable within five days.

rows.title: Detection is deterministic
rows.rule: Rules in the analytics layer; the LLM computes nothing; templated text with fact tokens.

rows.title: Detector catalogue
rows.rule: D1–D8 as detectors-1.1.

rows.title: Audience-scoped instances, three checks
rows.rule: Generation, delivery, every read; against current grants.

rows.title: Transparent scoring
rows.rule: impact × urgency; P1 ≥ 6, P2 3–5, P3 ≤ 2; Low → Watch; positive → P3.

rows.title: Shared lifecycle, personal triage
rows.rule: Shared and per-user states.

rows.title: Deduplicate, merge, re-notify, suppress
rows.rule: Band rise or ≥ 10% worse than the last notified version.

rows.title: Quiet by default
rows.rule: Logged decisions with reasons.

rows.title: Delivery
rows.rule: P1 in app; P2/P3 digest; Watch inbox only.

rows.title: Investigation handoff
rows.rule: Insight imported and labelled into a private thread.

rows.title: Feedback
rows.rule: Logged for review; no automatic threshold change; per-user mute.

rows.title: Scenario history
rows.rule: Declared history extension.

rows.title: Five-day priority (DX6)
rows.rule: Original core list.

rows.title: Evaluation cadence (DXQ-12 A)
rows.rule: Weekly, monthly on the as-of day, calendar months, events; all replay.

rows.title: Instances per authorized scope (DXQ-13 A)
rows.rule: Regional instances computed within each authorized region; operator and tenant never share.

rows.title: Tenant own-lease Watch and Action needed (DXQ-16 A)
rows.note: No tenant Watch in the current data after the S6 correction (GDQ-04).

rows.title: Canonical approval-age metric and as-of history
rows.rule: Parity live card; three new as-of metrics equal to parity at as_of; “waiting 31+ days”; no “overdue”.
rows.note: New metrics need KPI-catalog approval (DR-042); implementation route GDQ-03.

rows.title: Reconstructible scenario history
rows.rule: Series reproduced from record lifecycles; invariants GI-01…16.

rows.title: Replay oracle
rows.rule: Insights, versions, notifications and candidates only from replay.

rows.title: Private investigation threads
rows.rule: Owner only, re-authorized each read; others see status and role only.

rows.title: Explicit shared summaries
rows.rule: Owner-selected verified statements inside the instance scope.
rows.note: Secondary in five days; designed and tested.

rows.title: Uniform refusals
rows.rule: Same response for unauthorized and non-existent.

rows.title: Run identity and triggers
rows.rule: run_key over trigger, checkpoint, dataset, configuration, partition; event dedupe; one worker.

rows.title: Atomic publication and idempotent delivery
rows.rule: Staging; one transaction; optimistic version check; outbox keys.

rows.title: Restart, late and corrected data
rows.rule: Restart discards staging; ingested_at; corrections = new dataset version; stale label.

rows.title: Detector quality rules (detectors-1.1)
rows.rule: Versioned thresholds, minimum history, missing data, coverage, denominators, consecutive periods, no cross-entity associations.

rows.title: Scoring rules
rows.rule: Impact and urgency rules explicit.

rows.title: Watch promotion and clearing
rows.rule: Two periods → Medium Risk; else clears.

rows.title: Five-day priority for proactive work
rows.rule: Core incl. D8 and E2E tests; D3, D4, full D7, snooze, digest, feedback analytics secondary.

rows.title: Lease-scoped tenant actions
rows.rule: Never company-wide counts for a lease audience.
